name: Running Block 2 (post-5K)
goal: Aerobic base and repeat-effort capacity for padel. Not race times.

easy.pace: 12:45/mi home terrain (flat roads ~1 min/mi faster at same HR)
easy.cue: Talk test is the real rule. Perceived effort lags HR; trust the numbers.

sprint.cue: Sprint between two fixed landmarks. If a rep falls short of rep 1, stop.

baseline.pace: easy effort, 2 miles, flat, fresh legs
baseline.cue: Needs 2 days off running and no padel the day before. Compare to Sep 14: 12:48/mi @ HR 137. 12:45 @ <=135 = clearly fitter; 12:45 @ >=145 = fatigue/heat/undertraining (investigate, don't panic).

rules: At least one rest day between runs.
No quality session the day after padel.
Calves, kneecap or medial knee ache: swap quality for easy, or walk.
Skip sprint sessions if padel and fast-feet drills already covered repeat-sprint load that week.
Gait: short, quick steps; foot lands under the hips; let people pass on seafronts.
Glute activation before every run: bridges 2x15, right single-leg bridges 2x12, banded walks, clamshells.
